source.text: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ τοῖς ἁγίοις τοῖς οὖσιν ἐν Ἐφέσῳ καὶ πιστοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: Paul, apostle of Christ Jesus through [the] will of God, to the holy [ones] the [ones] being in Ephesus and faithful in Christ Jesus:

en.L: Paul, an apostle of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus through [the] will of God, to the holy ones who are in Ephesus and faithful in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus:
en.B: From Paul, an apostle of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus by the will of God, to God's holy people in Ephesus, who are faithful in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus.
en.R: This letter is from Paul. It was God's will that I should be an apostle, sent out by {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus. I am writing to God's holy people in Ephesus, who belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus and are faithful to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Pablo, apóstol {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} Jesús por [la] voluntad de Dios, a los santos que están en Éfeso y fieles en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} Jesús:
es.B: De Pablo, apóstol {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} Jesús por la voluntad de Dios, al pueblo santo de Dios en Éfeso, que es fiel en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús.
es.R: Esta carta es de Pablo. Dios quiso que yo fuera apóstol, enviado por {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús. Escribo al pueblo santo de Dios en Éfeso, que pertenece {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} Jesús y es fiel a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

sw.L: Paulo, mtume wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kupitia mapenzi ya Mungu, kwa watakatifu walioko Efeso na waaminifu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu:
sw.B: Kutoka kwa Paulo, mtume wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kwa mapenzi ya Mungu, kwa watu wa Mungu walio watakatifu huko Efeso, walio waaminifu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.
sw.R: Barua hii inatoka kwa Paulo. Mungu alitaka niwe mtume, niliyetumwa na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu. Ninawaandikia watu wa Mungu walio watakatifu huko Efeso, ambao ni mali ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu na ni waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.

fr.L: Paul, apôtre du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus par la volonté de Dieu, aux saints qui sont à Éphèse et fidèles {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus :
fr.B: De la part de Paul, apôtre du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus par la volonté de Dieu, au peuple saint de Dieu qui est à Éphèse, fidèle {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus.
fr.R: Cette lettre vient de Paul. Dieu a voulu que je sois apôtre, envoyé par le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus. J’écris au peuple saint de Dieu à Éphèse, à ceux qui appartiennent au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus et qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} sont fidèles.

ko.L: 하나님의 뜻을 통한 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수의 사도 바울이, 에베소에 있는 성도들, 곧 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 신실한 사람들에게 [편지합니다].
ko.B: 하나님의 뜻에 따라 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수의 사도가 된 바울이, 에베소에 있는 성도들, 곧 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 신실한 사람들에게 이 편지를 씁니다.
ko.R: 이 편지는 바울이 보냅니다. 나는 하나님의 뜻에 따라 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수께서 보내신 사도가 되었습니다. 나는 에베소에 사는 하나님의 거룩한 백성에게 이 편지를 씁니다. 여러분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수께 속해 있고, 그분께 신실합니다.

vi.L: Phao-lô, sứ đồ của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu bởi ý muốn của Đức Chúa Trời, gửi đến các thánh đồ ở Ê-phê-sô, là những người trung tín trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu:
vi.B: Phao-lô, sứ đồ của Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} theo ý muốn của Đức Chúa Trời, kính gửi dân thánh của Đức Chúa Trời tại Ê-phê-sô, là những người trung tín trong Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Thư này của Phao-lô. Đức Chúa Trời muốn tôi làm sứ đồ, là người được Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} sai đi. Tôi viết thư này cho dân thánh của Đức Chúa Trời ở Ê-phê-sô, là những người thuộc về Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} và trung tín với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

pt.L: Paulo, apóstolo {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} Jesus pela vontade de Deus, aos santos que estão em Éfeso e fiéis {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus:
pt.B: De Paulo, apóstolo {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} Jesus pela vontade de Deus, ao povo santo de Deus em Éfeso, que é fiel {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus.
pt.R: Esta carta é de Paulo. Foi da vontade de Deus que eu fosse apóstolo, enviado {{christos:por Cristo|pelo Messias}} Jesus. Escrevo ao povo santo de Deus em Éfeso, que pertence {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}} Jesus e é fiel a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.

am.L: ጳውሎስ፣ በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ሐዋርያ፣ በኤፌሶን ላሉት ቅዱሳን፣ {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስም ታማኞች ለሆኑ፦
am.B: በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ሐዋርያ ከሆነው ከጳውሎስ፣ በኤፌሶን ለሚኖሩና {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ታማኞች ለሆኑ ለእግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ሕዝብ።
am.R: ይህ ደብዳቤ ከጳውሎስ ነው። {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ የላከኝ ሐዋርያ እንድሆን የእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ ነበር። በኤፌሶን ለምትኖሩ ለእግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ሕዝብ እጽፋለሁ። እናንተ {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ናችሁ፤ ለእርሱም ታማኞች ናችሁ።

hi.L: पौलुस, जो परमेश्वर की इच्छा से मसीह यीशु का प्रेरित है, इफिसुस में रहनेवाले पवित्र जनों और मसीह यीशु में विश्वासयोग्य लोगों को:
hi.B: पौलुस की ओर से, जो परमेश्वर की इच्छा से मसीह यीशु का प्रेरित है, इफिसुस में परमेश्वर के पवित्र लोगों को, जो मसीह यीशु में विश्वासयोग्य हैं।
hi.R: यह पत्र पौलुस की ओर से है। परमेश्वर की इच्छा थी कि मैं प्रेरित बनूँ, जिसे मसीह यीशु ने भेजा है। मैं इफिसुस में रहनेवाले परमेश्वर के पवित्र लोगों को लिख रहा हूँ, जो मसीह यीशु के हैं और उनके प्रति विश्वासयोग्य हैं।

ru.L: Павел, апостол {{christos:Христа|Мессии}} Иисуса по воле Божьей, — святым, находящимся в Эфесе, и верным {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе:
ru.B: От Павла, апостола {{christos:Христа|Мессии}} Иисуса по воле Божьей, — святому народу Божьему в Эфесе, верным {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе.
ru.R: Это письмо от Павла. По воле Божьей я стал апостолом, посланным {{christos:Христом|Мессией}} Иисусом. Я пишу святому народу Божьему в Эфесе, тем, кто принадлежит {{christos:Христу|Мессии}} Иисусу и верен {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}.

uk.L: Павло, апостол {{christos:Христа|Месії}} Ісуса через волю Божу, святим, які є в Ефесі, і вірним {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі:
uk.B: Від Павла, апостола {{christos:Христа|Месії}} Ісуса з волі Божої, — святому Божому народові в Ефесі, вірним {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі.
uk.R: Цей лист від Павла. З волі Божої я став апостолом, якого послав {{christos:Христос|Месія}} Ісус. Я пишу святому Божому народові в Ефесі — тим, хто належить {{christos:Христові|Месії}} Ісусу і вірний {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}.

ja.L: 神の御心による{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスの使徒パウロから、エフェソにいる聖なる者たち、また{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスにあって忠実な者たちへ[手紙を送ります]。
ja.B: 神の御心によって{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスの使徒とされたパウロから、エフェソにいる神の聖なる民、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスに結ばれた忠実な人たちへ、この手紙を送ります。
ja.R: この手紙はパウロからのものです。わたしが{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスに遣わされた使徒となったのは、神がそう望まれたからです。わたしは、エフェソに住む神の民のみなさんに書いています。みなさんは{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスと一つにされ、この方に忠実に従っています。

id.L: Paulus, rasul {{christos:Kristus|Mesias}} Yesus oleh kehendak Allah, kepada orang-orang kudus yang ada di Efesus dan yang setia di dalam {{christos:Kristus|Mesias}} Yesus:
id.B: Dari Paulus, rasul {{christos:Kristus|Mesias}} Yesus oleh kehendak Allah, kepada orang-orang kudus di Efesus, yang setia di dalam {{christos:Kristus|Mesias}} Yesus.
id.R: Surat ini dari Paulus. Allah menghendaki saya menjadi rasul, utusan {{christos:Kristus|Mesias}} Yesus. Saya menulis kepada umat Allah di Efesus, yang menjadi milik {{christos:Kristus|Mesias}} Yesus dan setia kepada-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.

zh.L: 保罗，借着{{god_term:神|上帝}}的旨意[作]{{christos:基督|弥赛亚}}耶稣的使徒，致那些在以弗所、又在{{christos:基督|弥赛亚}}耶稣里忠心的圣徒：
zh.B: 这封信来自保罗，他照着{{god_term:神|上帝}}的旨意作了{{christos:基督|弥赛亚}}耶稣的使徒；这封信写给在以弗所属于{{god_term:神|上帝}}的圣徒，他们在{{christos:基督|弥赛亚}}耶稣里忠心耿耿。
zh.R: 这封信是保罗写的。{{god_term:神|上帝}}的旨意是要我作使徒，被{{christos:基督|弥赛亚}}耶稣差遣出去。我写信给在以弗所属于{{god_term:神|上帝}}的人。他们是{{christos:基督|弥赛亚}}耶稣的人，也对{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}忠心。

pa.L: ਪੌਲੁਸ, ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੀ ਇੱਛਾ ਦੇ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਮਸੀਹ ਯਿਸੂ ਦਾ ਰਸੂਲ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਜਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਅਫ਼ਸੁਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਮਸੀਹ ਯਿਸੂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਫ਼ਾਦਾਰ ਹਨ:
pa.B: ਪੌਲੁਸ ਵੱਲੋਂ, ਜਿਹੜਾ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੀ ਇੱਛਾ ਨਾਲ ਮਸੀਹ ਯਿਸੂ ਦਾ ਰਸੂਲ ਹੈ, ਅਫ਼ਸੁਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੇ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ, ਜਿਹੜੇ ਮਸੀਹ ਯਿਸੂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਫ਼ਾਦਾਰ ਹਨ।
pa.R: ਇਹ ਚਿੱਠੀ ਪੌਲੁਸ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਹੈ। ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੀ ਇਹ ਇੱਛਾ ਸੀ ਕਿ ਮੈਂ ਰਸੂਲ ਬਣਾਂ, ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਮਸੀਹ ਯਿਸੂ ਨੇ ਭੇਜਿਆ ਹੈ। ਮੈਂ ਅਫ਼ਸੁਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੇ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਲਿਖ ਰਿਹਾ ਹਾਂ, ਜਿਹੜੇ ਮਸੀਹ ਯਿਸੂ ਦੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਵਫ਼ਾਦਾਰ ਹਨ।

fa.L: پولس، رسول مسیح عیسی به ارادهٔ خدا، به مقدسانی که در افسس هستند و در مسیح عیسی امین‌اند:
fa.B: از پولس، که به ارادهٔ خدا رسول مسیح عیسی است، به قوم مقدس خدا در افسس، که در مسیح عیسی امین‌اند.
fa.R: این نامه از پولس است. خدا چنین خواست که من رسول باشم، فرستادهٔ مسیح عیسی. به قوم مقدس خدا در افسس می‌نویسم، که از آن مسیح عیسی هستند و به او وفادارند.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "in Ephesus"
alternatives: leave out "in Ephesus": "to the holy ones who are also faithful in Christ Jesus"
decisions.reason: Some of the earliest manuscripts, among them P46 and the first hands of Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus, do not have ἐν Ἐφέσῳ; almost all later manuscripts do. Without the place name the Greek is awkward ("to the holy ones who are and faithful"). The letter has no personal greetings and speaks of the readers' faith as something Paul has heard about (1:15; 3:2), so it may have been written for several churches in the province of Asia, with Ephesus as its chief city. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: apostle: a messenger sent out with the authority of the one who sends him
alternatives: a missionary or church worker in general
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 1:1: ἀπόστολος means one who is sent, and Paul counts himself among those commissioned by the risen Christ (1 Corinthians 15:7-9; Galatians 1:1). He holds the role "through the will of God".

decisions.choice: faithful: loyal and true to Christ; the same people as the holy ones
alternatives: a second, smaller group within the church
decisions.reason: πιστοῖς can mean "believing" or "faithful". "Holy" and "faithful" describe one group, the whole church, as in Colossians 1:2. The letter takes their faith for granted (1:15) and urges them to stay true (4:1; 6:10-13).

decisions.choice: Ephesus: the leading city of the Roman province of Asia, a port on the west coast of what is now Turkey
decisions.reason: The city was famous for its great temple of Artemis (Acts 19:27-35). Paul worked there for over two years (Acts 19:8-10; 20:31).

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: God's holy people
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 1:2 and Philippians 1:1: in current English "saints" suggests unusually good people, not a whole congregation.

decisions.choice: It was God's will that I should be an apostle, sent out by {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus; who belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus and are faithful to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}
alternatives: an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God; faithful in Christ Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable says what an apostle is, as Colossians 1:1 does, and spells out "faithful in Christ Jesus": they are joined to him and loyal to him (m3).

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans only on free pronouns and possessives (kwake, yake, wake, zake, yeye)
alternatives: a span on every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns inside the verb (a-li-tu-chagua), and a prefix cannot take a capital. So in this chapter the setting applies to free words such as "ndani yake", "utukufu wake", "nguvu zake" and "waaminifu kwake", and Swahili has fewer spans than the English.

decisions.choice: "du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}", "le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}", "au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}"; "{{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}" for Paul's "in Christ" (for the whole letter)
alternatives: {{christos:Christ|Messie}} with the article inside the span
decisions.reason: As in Colossians: French cannot say "en Messie", because the title needs an article and "en" does not take one, so the span for "in Christ" covers the preposition, with the familiar "en Christ" as the default. Elsewhere the article stays outside the span, since both "le Christ" and "le Messie" are good French.

decisions.choice: passé composé for past events at every level (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: Ephesians is a letter: Paul tells the readers what God has done for them and what they heard and received, and French uses the passé composé for that ("Dieu nous a choisis", "vous avez entendu"), as in Colossians. The letter has no narrative that would call for the passé simple.

decisions.choice: aux saints (L); au peuple saint de Dieu (B); au peuple saint de Dieu, au peuple de Dieu (R) (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians and as in the English: in current French "les saints" suggests people of exceptional goodness or those canonized by the church, not a whole congregation. Literal keeps the word so the reader can follow it.

decisions.choice: the whole letter in 합쇼체 (-습니다, -십시오) at every level; the readers are "여러분"; Paul speaks of himself as "나" and "우리"; God and Christ take the honorific -시- and 께서; no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: As in the Korean of Colossians, written at the same time: a letter read aloud to the gathered church calls for the formal style of a public address, so every level uses 합쇼체, and "여러분" is the respectful plural "you". Korean has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change, and the Korean text has no deity_pronoun spans; respect for God and Christ is carried by -시-, 께서 and "그분".

decisions.choice: "성도" (L, B); "하나님의 거룩한 백성" (R), for the holy ones through the letter; {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} at every level
decisions.reason: As in Colossians and Romans: "성도" is the ordinary Korean church word for every believer, and does not suggest unusually good people, so it serves Literal and Balanced; Readable says the plain sense. Korean has no article, so the christos alternative is plain "메시아".

decisions.choice: "에베소"
decisions.reason: The established Protestant Korean form of the city's name.

decisions.choice: "tôi" for Paul, "chúng tôi" for Paul and those with him, "chúng ta" where the readers are included, and "anh chị em" for "you" (plural) through the whole letter
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Colossians and Romans, Paul is "tôi" and the churches he writes to are "anh chị em", the warm, inclusive form Vietnamese churches use. In chapters 1-2, where Paul sets "we" (Jewish believers) beside "you" (Gentiles), "chúng tôi" and "anh chị em" keep the two apart, and "chúng ta" joins them.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu (L), Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} (B, R) for "Christ Jesus"; {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} for "Christ" alone; Chúa Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} for "the Lord Jesus Christ" (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: The forms set in the Vietnamese Colossians: Literal keeps the Greek order, title first, and Balanced and Readable put the name first, which reads naturally.

decisions.choice: "các thánh đồ" (L); "dân thánh của Đức Chúa Trời" (B, R) for the holy ones (for the whole letter); "Ê-phê-sô"
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Colossians (1:2-4): "thánh đồ" keeps the single Greek word at Literal, and Balanced and Readable say "God's holy people", so that the whole church is plainly meant; "các thánh" would be heard as canonised saints.

decisions.choice: os santos (L); o povo santo de Deus (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as docs/portuguese-style.md section 6 sets it. In Brazil "os santos" suggests a few canonised saints; the word means the whole church, set apart for God (m3), so Balanced and Readable say "o povo santo de Deus". Literal keeps "santos".

decisions.choice: {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} Jesus; {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus
decisions.reason: For the whole book. Portuguese contracts "de", "em", "a" and "por" with the article of "o Messias", so the preposition goes inside both options ("em Cristo", "no Messias"); otherwise the alternative would read "em o Messias". Where "Cristo" stands without a preposition, the alternative carries the article: {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God and Christ has nothing to change in Amharic; the pronouns ("እርሱ", the verb endings) are written plainly through the letter.

decisions.choice: {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ, {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ: the prefix inside each option
decisions.reason: As in Romans, a prefix or suffix is written in each option, so both read as whole words. With the name Jesus the alternative takes the definite form "መሲሑ" (the Messiah Jesus); without the name it is "መሲሕ" where the Greek has no article and "መሲሑ" where it has one.

decisions.choice: ቅዱሳን (L); ለእግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ሕዝብ (God's holy people, B, R)
decisions.reason: "ቅዱሳን" alone can sound like canonised saints of the church calendar; Balanced and Readable say whose holy people they are, as the English does. Literal keeps the one Greek word.

decisions.choice: "मसीह" with no christos setting
decisions.reason: "मसीह" is both the familiar name in "मसीह यीशु" and the word Messiah itself, so the choice the English setting offers is already made (style guide, section 7). The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans; honorific forms for Christ and God ("उनके प्रति")
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi. Respect for God and Christ comes from the honorific third person at every level (style guide, sections 4 and 7). The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "पवित्र जन" (L); "पवित्र लोग" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Acts and Romans: the holy ones are God's whole people; "सन्त" would suggest a few exceptional holy men. The same through the letter.

decisions.choice: "इफिसुस"
decisions.reason: The spelling of the city's name in Acts.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Христа|Мессии}} Иисуса; {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе
decisions.reason: The title setting with the case ending, and the preposition, inside each option, as in Romans and Galatians.

decisions.choice: святые (L); святой народ Божий (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 1:2: "святые" now suggests unusually holy people, so Balanced and Readable say whose holy people they are.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Христа|Месії}} Ісуса; {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі
decisions.reason: The title setting carries its case ending inside each option, and with "in" the preposition too, since Ukrainian writes "у Христі" but "в Месії". Used so throughout Ephesians.

decisions.choice: святі (L); святий Божий народ (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Святі" on its own now suggests people of unusual holiness; Balanced and Readable say whose holy people they are, as the English does. Kept so through the letter.

decisions.choice: "{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}にあって" (L); "{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}に結ばれて" (B); "{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}と一つにされて" (R)
alternatives: "キリストのうちに" at every level
decisions.reason: Settled here for Ephesians: "in Christ", "in him" and "in whom" run through the letter and mean union with Christ (1:3 m5). Literal keeps the old church phrase にあって, which mirrors the Greek preposition; Balanced says plainly that believers are joined to him; Readable says they have been made one with him. Where the phrase describes God's own act or plan rather than believers' union (1:9, 1:20), Balanced and Readable say のうちに or によって instead.

decisions.choice: "聖なる者たち" (L); "神の聖なる民" (B); "神の民" (R), for the whole letter
alternatives: "聖なる者たち" at every level
decisions.reason: The holy ones are the whole congregation, set apart for God (m3). "聖徒" now suggests specially holy individuals, as "saints" does in English; Balanced and Readable say whose people they are, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "御心" (L, B) for God's will through the letter (1:1, 5, 9, 11; 5:17; 6:6); Readable says what God wants ("神がそう望まれた")
decisions.reason: "御心" is the word Japanese uses for the will of God, and Romans uses it too, so the letters read alike. "意志" sounds like a person's will-power. Readable keeps everyday words and says what God wanted, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "{{christos:Kristus|Mesias}} Yesus" in Paul's order; "Yesus {{christos:Kristus|Mesias}}" (L) and "Yesus {{christos:Kristus|Sang Mesias}}" (B, R) where the name comes first
decisions.reason: For the whole of Ephesians, as the Indonesian style guide sets (section 8): every christos span of the English has one in Indonesian.

decisions.choice: Paul says "aku" (L, B) and "saya" (R); the readers are "kalian"; "orang kudus" (L, B), "umat Allah" (R); no gender spans
decisions.reason: For the whole of Ephesians, as the style guide sets (sections 5, 7, 8): the letter writer's voice, the plural "you", the glossary words for the saints. Indonesian "anak", "saudara" and "manusia" already include women and men, so the English gender spans of the letter have no Indonesian counterpart.

decisions.choice: {{god_term:神|上帝}} for every word naming God
decisions.reason: The Chinese reader setting: "神" by default, "上帝" as the alternative (style guide section 4). It changes the word, never the meaning; this note stands for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: {{christos:基督|弥赛亚}}耶稣 in Paul's order
decisions.reason: Where the Greek has "Christ Jesus" the Chinese keeps that order (基督耶稣 / 弥赛亚耶稣); where it has "Jesus Christ" (1:2, 3, 5, 17) it writes 耶稣基督, as in Romans. The title setting works as in English.

decisions.choice: "圣徒" (L, B); "属于{{god_term:神|上帝}}的人" (R)
decisions.reason: The glossary's word for the holy ones, as in Romans: "圣徒" at Literal and Balanced, where Balanced adds "属于神的" for the English "God's holy people"; Readable says what the word means. Kept through the letter.

decisions.choice: 致那些在以弗所、又在基督耶稣里忠心的圣徒
alternatives: 致在以弗所的圣徒，就是在基督耶稣里忠心的人
decisions.reason: Chinese puts both descriptions before the noun; "又" keeps the Greek "and": the faithful are the same people as the holy ones (m3).

decisions.choice: "ਮਸੀਹ" with no christos setting
decisions.reason: Christos as Jesus' title and name; Punjabi uses one word for both (style §8).

decisions.choice: "ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਜਨ" (L); "ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਲੋਕ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Hagioi, those set apart for God, as in Colossians and Philippians.

decisions.choice: "ਅਫ਼ਸੁਸ"
decisions.reason: Ephesus, spelled as in 2 Timothy.

decisions.choice: "مسیح" with no christos span
decisions.reason: Persian uses مسیح for both senses.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans; "او" for Christ and God (Readable)
decisions.reason: Persian has no capital letters.

decisions.choice: "مقدسان" (Literal); "قوم مقدس خدا" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Hagioi, as in Romans and Corinthians.

decisions.choice: "افسس"
decisions.reason: The usual Persian form of Ephesus.

source.text: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

fa.L: فیض و سلامتی از جانب خدا، پدر ما، و خداوند عیسی مسیح بر شما باد.
fa.B: فیض و سلامتی از جانب خدا، پدر ما، و خداوند عیسی مسیح بر شما باد.
fa.R: خدا، پدر ما، و خداوند عیسی مسیح به شما فیض عطا کنند و سلامتی بخشند.

decisions.choice: grace and peace: God's free kindness, and the wholeness and well-being he gives
alternatives: an ordinary letter greeting with no special weight
decisions.reason: Greek letters opened with a word of greeting from the same root as χάρις; Paul makes it a prayer for God's grace, and adds εἰρήνη, which stands for the Hebrew greeting shalom, the full well-being God gives. Both words return in the letter (2:5-8; 2:14-17).

decisions.choice: one source: God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ together
alternatives: two separate sources of two separate gifts
decisions.reason: One preposition, ἀπὸ, governs both names, so the Father and the Lord Jesus are named together as the one source of grace and peace, as in Paul's other greetings (Romans 1:7; Philippians 1:2).

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} show you grace and give you peace
alternatives: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
decisions.reason: Readable makes the greeting a prayer, as Colossians 1:2 and Philippians 1:2 do.

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: Paul writes to the church in the plural. Every plural "you" and its verb is a reader setting: ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain), as in Philippians 4.

decisions.choice: "은혜와 평안" at every level, through the letter
decisions.reason: The key terms take the words settled for the Korean of John, Colossians and Romans: "은혜" for grace and "평안" for the peace God gives. "평화" is kept for peace between people who were enemies (2:14-17).

decisions.choice: ጸጋ (grace) and ሰላም (peace) at every level, through the letter
decisions.reason: The key terms keep the words settled for Romans: "ጸጋ" is God's free, undeserved gift and favour and is current in everyday Amharic, so Readable keeps it too; "ሞገስ" and "ቸርነት" each say only part of it.

decisions.choice: the greeting in the words of Romans 1:7
decisions.reason: The Greek is the same as Romans 1:7, so each level keeps that greeting, and the letters open alike.

decisions.choice: Paul addresses the Ephesians as "तुम"
decisions.reason: As in Romans and Galatians: Paul writes to believers as one of them, and believers say "तुम" among themselves. The same through the letter.

decisions.choice: благодать ... мир
decisions.reason: The greeting follows Romans 1:7 at each level; "благодать" is the key term at every level.

decisions.choice: "恩典与平安……归给你们" (L); "愿你们……得着恩典与平安" (B); "愿你们……那里得到恩典和平安" (R)
alternatives: 愿神我们的父和主耶稣基督向你们施恩，赐你们平安 (R, as the English Readable's two verbs)
decisions.reason: The letter greeting in the form Romans 1:7 settled for Paul's letters (style guide section 12); 恩典 is the key term for grace. Readable keeps that form rather than the English Readable's two verbs; the meaning (one source, m2) is the same.

decisions.choice: Paul addresses the Ephesians as "ਤੁਸੀਂ"
decisions.reason: The letter is to a church, so the plural.

decisions.choice: The greeting in the words of Romans 1:7
decisions.reason: Paul's greeting formula.

decisions.choice: Paul addresses the Ephesians as "شما"
decisions.reason: A letter to a church.

source.text: Εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ εὐλογήσας ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ εὐλογίᾳ πνευματικῇ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ἐν Χριστῷ, καθὼς ἐξελέξατο ἡμᾶς ἐν αὐτῷ πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου, εἶναι ἡμᾶς ἁγίους καὶ ἀμώμους κατενώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀγάπῃ, προορίσας ἡμᾶς εἰς υἱοθεσίαν διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς αὐτόν, κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ, εἰς ἔπαινον δόξης τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἧς ἐχαρίτωσεν ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ ἠγαπημένῳ, ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν διὰ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ, τὴν ἄφεσιν τῶν παραπτωμάτων, κατὰ τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἧς ἐπερίσσευσεν εἰς ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ καὶ φρονήσει γνωρίσας ἡμῖν τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ, κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν αὐτοῦ ἣν προέθετο ἐν αὐτῷ εἰς οἰκονομίαν τοῦ πληρώματος τῶν καιρῶν, ἀνακεφαλαιώσασθαι τὰ πάντα ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ, τὰ ἐπὶ τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς· ἐν αὐτῷ, ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἐκληρώθημεν προορισθέντες κατὰ πρόθεσιν τοῦ τὰ πάντα ἐνεργοῦντος κατὰ τὴν βουλὴν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ, εἰς τὸ εἶναι ἡμᾶς εἰς ἔπαινον δόξης αὐτοῦ τοὺς προηλπικότας ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ·

records.literal_gloss: Blessed [be] the God and Father of the Lord of us Jesus Christ, the [one] having blessed us in every blessing spiritual in the heavenly [places] in Christ, \v 4 just as he chose us in him before [the] foundation of [the] world, to be us holy and blameless before him in love, \v 5 having predestined us to adoption-as-sons through Jesus Christ to him, according to the good pleasure of the will of him, \v 6 to [the] praise of [the] glory of the grace of him, which he graced us in the [one] having been loved, \v 7 in whom we have the redemption through the blood of him, the forgiveness of the trespasses, according to the riches of the grace of him, \v 8 which he made abound to us in all wisdom and insight, \v 9 having made known to us the mystery of the will of him, according to the good pleasure of him, which he purposed in him \v 10 for [the] administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up the all things in the Christ, the [things] on the heavens and the [things] on the earth; in him, \v 11 in whom also we were allotted, having been predestined according to [the] purpose of the [one] the all things working according to the counsel of the will of him, \v 12 for the to be us for [the] praise of glory of him, the [ones] having hoped-before in the Christ;

en.L: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly [places] in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, \v 4 just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose us in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} before [the] foundation of [the] world, that we should be holy and blameless before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in love, \v 5 having predestined us for adoption as {{gender:sons and daughters|sons}} through Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, according to the good pleasure of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} will, \v 6 to [the] praise of [the] glory of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace, with which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} graced us in the Beloved, \v 7 in whom we have the redemption through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} blood, the forgiveness of trespasses, according to the riches of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace, \v 8 which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made abound toward us in all wisdom and insight, \v 9 having made known to us the mystery of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} will, according to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} good pleasure, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} purposed in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \v 10 for [the] administration of the fullness of the times: to sum up all things in the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \v 11 in whom also we were made [God's] inheritance, having been predestined according to [the] purpose of the [one] who works all things according to the counsel of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} will, \v 12 so that we, who had first hoped in the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, should be to [the] praise of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory;
en.B: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. In {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has blessed us with every blessing the Spirit gives in the heavenly places. \v 4 Even before the world was founded, God chose us in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, so that we would be holy and without blemish before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in love. \v 5 He marked us out beforehand to be adopted as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own {{gender:sons and daughters|sons}} through Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. That was what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gladly willed, \v 6 so that {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glorious grace would be praised, the grace {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has freely given us in the Beloved. \v 7 In {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} blood we have redemption, the forgiveness of our wrongdoing. We have it because God's grace is so rich, \v 8 grace that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has poured out on us in abundance, with all wisdom and understanding. \v 9 He has made known to us the mystery of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} will, as it pleased {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to do. He set out this purpose in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} \v 10 as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} plan for when the times reach their fullness: to bring all things together under one head in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, things in heaven and things on earth, all in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 11 In {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} we too have been claimed as God's own portion. We were marked out for this beforehand by the purpose of God, who works out everything as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} will determines, \v 12 so that we who were the first to hope in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} would bring praise to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.
en.R: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}! Because we are joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, God has blessed us with every blessing the Spirit brings, blessings from the heavenly world. \v 4 Even before {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made the world, God chose us to be joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. He chose us to be holy and without fault in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sight, and to live in love. \v 5 Long ago God decided to adopt us through Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own {{gender:sons and daughters|sons}}, with all the rights of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} children. That is what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wanted, and it gave {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} joy. \v 6 He did this so that {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glorious grace would be praised. He has given us this grace freely in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} dearly loved Son. \v 7 Through the blood of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Son we have been set free, and our wrongs are forgiven. That is how rich God's grace is, \v 8 and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has poured it out on us in full measure. He has given us all wisdom and understanding. \v 9 He has let us know the mystery of what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wanted to do: {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} plan, once hidden, now made known. God was glad to make this plan, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made it to be carried out through {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. \v 10 This is God's plan for the time {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has set: to bring everything in heaven and on earth together, with {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} as head over them all. \v 11 Because we are joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, God has made us {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own people, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} treasured share. He decided this long before. God makes everything happen the way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has planned and willed. \v 12 He did this so that we, who were the first to put our hope in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, would bring praise to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.

es.L: Bendito [sea] el Dios y Padre de nuestro Señor Jesús {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, que nos ha bendecido con toda bendición espiritual en los [lugares] celestiales en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, \v 4 así como nos eligió en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} antes de [la] fundación del mundo, para que fuéramos santos y sin mancha delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en amor, \v 5 habiéndonos predestinado para adopción como hijos por medio de Jesús {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} para {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}, según el beneplácito de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad, \v 6 para alabanza de [la] gloria de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia, con la cual nos agració en el Amado, \v 7 en quien tenemos la redención por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sangre, el perdón de [las] transgresiones, según las riquezas de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia, \v 8 que hizo abundar hacia nosotros en toda sabiduría y entendimiento, \v 9 dándonos a conocer el misterio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad, según {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} beneplácito, que se propuso en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} \v 10 para [la] administración de la plenitud de los tiempos: reunir todas las cosas en el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, las [cosas] en los cielos y las [cosas] sobre la tierra, en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \v 11 en quien también fuimos hechos herencia [de Dios], habiendo sido predestinados según [el] propósito del que realiza todas las cosas según el consejo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad, \v 12 a fin de que nosotros, los que antes hemos esperado en el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, seamos para alabanza de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria;
es.B: Bendito sea el Dios y Padre de nuestro Señor Jesús {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}. En {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} nos ha bendecido con toda bendición que da el Espíritu en los lugares celestiales. \v 4 Antes de que el mundo fuera fundado, Dios nos eligió en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} para que fuéramos santos y sin mancha delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en amor. \v 5 De antemano nos destinó a ser adoptados como {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} propios hijos por medio de Jesús {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}. Eso fue lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiso con agrado, \v 6 para que fuera alabada {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloriosa gracia, la gracia que nos ha dado gratuitamente en el Amado. \v 7 En {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sangre tenemos la redención, el perdón de nuestras faltas. La tenemos porque la gracia de Dios es muy rica, \v 8 gracia que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha derramado sobre nosotros en abundancia, con toda sabiduría y entendimiento. \v 9 Nos ha dado a conocer el misterio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad, como a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le agradó hacerlo. Se propuso este plan en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} \v 10 como {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} designio para cuando los tiempos llegaran a su plenitud: reunir todas las cosas bajo una sola cabeza en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, las que están en el cielo y las que están en la tierra, todo en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \v 11 En {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} también nosotros hemos llegado a ser la porción propia de Dios. Para esto fuimos destinados de antemano por el propósito de Dios, que lo lleva a cabo todo como {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad lo determina, \v 12 para que nosotros, los primeros en poner nuestra esperanza en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, seamos para alabanza de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.
es.R: ¡Alabemos al Dios y Padre de nuestro Señor Jesús {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}! Porque estamos unidos {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}, Dios nos ha bendecido con toda bendición que trae el Espíritu, bendiciones del mundo celestial. \v 4 Aun antes de crear el mundo, Dios nos eligió para que estuviéramos unidos {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}. Nos eligió para que fuéramos santos y sin falta ante {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ojos, y para que viviéramos en amor. \v 5 Hace mucho tiempo Dios decidió adoptarnos por medio de Jesús {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} como {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} propios hijos, con todos los derechos que tienen los hijos. Eso es lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quería, y eso {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dio alegría. \v 6 Lo hizo para que {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloriosa gracia fuera alabada. Nos ha dado esta gracia gratuitamente en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo amado. \v 7 Por la sangre de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo hemos sido liberados, y nuestras malas acciones están perdonadas. Así de rica es la gracia de Dios, \v 8 y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} la ha derramado sobre nosotros en abundancia. Nos ha dado toda sabiduría y entendimiento. \v 9 Nos ha dejado conocer el misterio de lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quería hacer: {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} plan, antes escondido, ahora dado a conocer. A Dios le alegró hacer este plan, y lo hizo para llevarlo a cabo por medio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}. \v 10 Este es el plan de Dios para el tiempo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha fijado: reunir todo lo que hay en el cielo y en la tierra, con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} como cabeza de todo. \v 11 Porque estamos unidos {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}, Dios nos ha hecho {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio pueblo, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} porción preciosa. Lo decidió hace mucho tiempo. Dios hace que todo suceda como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo ha planeado y querido. \v 12 Lo hizo para que nosotros, los primeros en poner nuestra esperanza en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, diéramos alabanza a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.

sw.L: Abarikiwe Mungu na Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, aliyetubariki kwa kila baraka ya kiroho katika [mahali pa] mbinguni katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, \v 4 kama alivyotuchagua ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kabla ya kuwekwa misingi ya ulimwengu, ili tuwe watakatifu na bila lawama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} katika upendo, \v 5 akiisha kutuamulia tangu awali tufanywe wana kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, kulingana na radhi ya mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \v 6 kwa sifa ya utukufu wa neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, ambayo alituneemesha nayo katika Mpendwa, \v 7 ambaye ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} tuna ukombozi kupitia damu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, msamaha wa makosa, kulingana na utajiri wa neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \v 8 aliyoizidisha kwetu katika hekima yote na ufahamu, \v 9 akiisha kutufahamisha siri ya mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kulingana na radhi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, aliyoikusudia ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} \v 10 kwa mpango wa utimilifu wa nyakati: kuviunganisha vitu vyote katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, vitu vilivyo mbinguni na vitu vilivyo duniani, ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \v 11 ambaye ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} pia tulifanywa urithi [wa Mungu], tukiisha kuamuliwa tangu awali kulingana na kusudi la yule anayetenda vitu vyote kulingana na uamuzi wa mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \v 12 ili sisi, tuliokwisha kutumaini mapema katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, tuwe kwa sifa ya utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}};
sw.B: Ahimidiwe Mungu na Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ametubariki kwa kila baraka itokayo kwa Roho katika ulimwengu wa mbinguni. \v 4 Hata kabla ulimwengu haujaumbwa, Mungu alituchagua ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, ili tuwe watakatifu na bila dosari mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} katika upendo. \v 5 Alitutenga tangu awali tufanywe wana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Ndivyo alivyopenda kufanya kwa moyo mkunjufu, \v 6 ili neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yenye utukufu isifiwe, neema ambayo ametupa bure katika yule Mpendwa. \v 7 Ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, na kupitia damu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, tuna ukombozi, msamaha wa makosa yetu. Tunao kwa sababu neema ya Mungu ni tele, \v 8 neema ambayo ameimimina juu yetu kwa wingi, pamoja na hekima yote na ufahamu. \v 9 Ametujulisha siri ya mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kama ilivyompendeza kufanya. Aliweka kusudi hili ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} \v 10 kuwa mpango {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwa wakati nyakati zitakapotimia: kuviunganisha vitu vyote chini ya kichwa kimoja ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, vitu vya mbinguni na vitu vya duniani, vyote ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \v 11 Ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} sisi pia tumefanywa fungu la Mungu mwenyewe. Tuliamuliwa kwa ajili ya jambo hili tangu awali kwa kusudi la Mungu, anayetenda kila kitu kama mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yanavyoamua, \v 12 ili sisi, tuliokuwa wa kwanza kuweka tumaini letu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, tuuletee utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} sifa.
sw.R: Tumsifu Mungu, Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}! Kwa sababu tumeunganishwa na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Mungu ametubariki kwa kila baraka ambayo Roho huleta, baraka kutoka mbinguni. \v 4 Hata kabla hajaumba ulimwengu, Mungu alituchagua tuunganishwe na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Alituchagua tuwe watakatifu na bila kosa machoni {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}}, na tuishi kwa upendo. \v 5 Zamani sana Mungu aliamua kutufanya wana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, tukiwa na haki zote za watoto {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Ndivyo alivyotaka, na jambo hilo lilimfurahisha. \v 6 Alifanya hivyo ili neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yenye utukufu isifiwe. Ametupa neema hii bure katika Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mpendwa. \v 7 Kupitia damu ya Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} tumewekwa huru, na makosa yetu yamesamehewa. Ndivyo neema ya Mungu ilivyo tele, \v 8 naye ameimimina juu yetu kwa wingi. Ametupa hekima yote na ufahamu. \v 9 Ametujulisha siri ya kile alichotaka kufanya: mpango {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, uliokuwa umefichwa, sasa umejulishwa. Mungu alifurahi kufanya mpango huu, naye aliufanya ili utimizwe kupitia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. \v 10 Huu ndio mpango wa Mungu kwa wakati alioupanga: kuunganisha kila kitu kilicho mbinguni na duniani, {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} akiwa kichwa juu ya vyote. \v 11 Kwa sababu tumeunganishwa na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Mungu ametufanya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe, fungu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} la thamani. Aliamua hivyo zamani sana. Mungu hufanya kila kitu kitokee jinsi alivyopanga na kutaka. \v 12 Alifanya hivyo ili utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usifiwe kwa sababu yetu sisi, tuliokuwa wa kwanza kuweka tumaini letu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

fr.L: Béni [soit] le Dieu et Père de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, qui nous a bénis de toute bénédiction spirituelle dans les [lieux] célestes {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, \v 4 selon qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a choisis en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avant la fondation du monde, pour que nous soyons saints et sans tache devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dans l’amour, \v 5 nous ayant prédestinés à l’adoption comme {{gender:fils et filles|fils}} par Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} pour {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}, selon le bon plaisir de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} volonté, \v 6 à [la] louange de [la] gloire de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce, dont {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a gratifiés dans le Bien-Aimé, \v 7 en qui nous avons la rédemption par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sang, le pardon des fautes, selon la richesse de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce, \v 8 qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait abonder envers nous en toute sagesse et intelligence, \v 9 nous ayant fait connaître le mystère de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} volonté, selon {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bon plaisir, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’était proposé en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} \v 10 pour [l’]administration de la plénitude des temps : réunir toutes choses sous un seul chef dans le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, les choses dans les cieux et les choses sur la terre, en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \v 11 en qui aussi nous avons été faits [l’]héritage [de Dieu], ayant été prédestinés selon [le] dessein de celui qui opère toutes choses selon le conseil de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} volonté, \v 12 pour que nous soyons à [la] louange de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, nous qui avons d’avance espéré dans le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ;
fr.B: Béni soit le Dieu et Père de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}. {{christos:En Christ|Dans le Messie}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a bénis de toutes les bénédictions que donne l’Esprit dans les lieux célestes. \v 4 Avant même la fondation du monde, Dieu nous a choisis {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, pour que nous soyons saints et sans tache devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dans l’amour. \v 5 Il nous a destinés d’avance à être adoptés comme {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} propres {{gender:fils et filles|fils}} par Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}. C’est ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a voulu, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a voulu avec joie, \v 6 pour que soit louée {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce glorieuse, la grâce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a donnée gratuitement dans le Bien-Aimé. \v 7 En {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sang, nous avons la rédemption, le pardon de nos fautes. Nous l’avons parce que la grâce de Dieu est si riche, \v 8 cette grâce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a répandue sur nous en abondance, avec toute sagesse et toute intelligence. \v 9 Il nous a fait connaître le mystère de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} volonté, comme il {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a plu de le faire. Ce dessein, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a établi {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} \v 10 comme {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} plan pour le moment où les temps seraient accomplis : réunir toutes choses sous un seul chef, le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, ce qui est dans le ciel et ce qui est sur la terre, tout en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \v 11 En {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, nous aussi, nous sommes devenus la part qui appartient à Dieu. Nous y avons été destinés d’avance par le dessein de Dieu, qui accomplit tout comme {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} volonté le décide, \v 12 afin que nous, les premiers à avoir espéré dans le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, nous servions à la louange de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.
fr.R: Louons le Dieu et Père de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} ! Parce que nous sommes unis au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, Dieu nous a donné toutes les bénédictions que l’Esprit apporte, des bénédictions qui viennent du monde céleste. \v 4 Avant même de créer le monde, Dieu nous a choisis pour que nous soyons unis au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. Il nous a choisis pour que nous soyons saints et sans défaut à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} yeux, et pour que nous vivions dans l’amour. \v 5 Il y a très longtemps, Dieu a décidé de nous adopter par Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, pour que nous soyons {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} propres {{gender:fils et filles|fils}}, avec tous les droits de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} enfants. C’est ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} voulait, et cela {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a donné de la joie. \v 6 Il l’a fait pour que tous louent {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce glorieuse. Cette grâce, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous l’a donnée gratuitement par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils bien-aimé. \v 7 Par le sang de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils, nous avons été libérés, et nos fautes sont pardonnées. Voilà combien la grâce de Dieu est riche ! \v 8 Il l’a répandue sur nous sans compter. Il nous a donné toute la sagesse et toute l’intelligence. \v 9 Il nous a fait connaître le mystère de ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} voulait faire : {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} plan, autrefois caché, maintenant révélé. Dieu a été heureux de former ce plan, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a formé pour qu’il se réalise par le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. \v 10 Voici le plan de Dieu pour le moment qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fixé : réunir tout ce qui est dans le ciel et sur la terre, avec le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} comme chef de tout. \v 11 Parce que nous sommes unis au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, Dieu a fait de nous {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre peuple, {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} part précieuse. Il l’avait décidé bien avant. Dieu fait tout arriver comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a prévu et voulu. \v 12 Il l’a fait pour que nous, les premiers à mettre notre espérance dans le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, nous fassions louer {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.

ko.L: 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 하나님 아버지를 찬송합니다. 그분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 하늘에 [속한 곳들]에서 모든 영적인 복으로 우리에게 복을 주셨습니다. \v 4 그분은 세상의 기초를 놓기 전에 그 안에서 우리를 택하셔서, 우리가 사랑 안에서 그분 앞에 거룩하고 흠이 없게 하셨습니다. \v 5 그분은 그분의 뜻의 기쁘신 뜻을 따라, 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통하여 우리를 미리 정하셔서 자기의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}가 되게 하셨습니다. \v 6 [이는] 그분이 사랑하시는 분 안에서 우리에게 은혜로 베푸신 그분의 은혜의 영광을 찬송하게 하려는 것입니다. \v 7 그 아들 안에서 우리는 그분의 피를 통한 속량, 곧 범죄들의 용서를 받았으니, 그분의 은혜의 풍성함을 따른 것입니다. \v 8 그분은 이 은혜를 모든 지혜와 총명으로 우리에게 넘치게 하셨고, \v 9 그 안에서 미리 세우신 그분의 기쁘신 뜻을 따라 그분의 뜻의 비밀을 우리에게 알려 주셨습니다. \v 10 [그것은] 때가 차는 경륜을 위한 것으로, 하늘에 있는 것들과 땅에 있는 것들, 곧 모든 것을 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 하나로 모으시는 것입니다. [모든 것이] 그 안에서 [하나가 됩니다]. \v 11 그 안에서 우리도 [하나님의] 몫이 되었습니다. 모든 것을 자기 뜻의 계획대로 이루시는 분의 목적을 따라 우리가 미리 정해졌기 때문입니다. \v 12 이는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께 먼저 소망을 둔 우리가 그분의 영광을 찬송하게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 하나님 아버지를 찬송합니다. 하나님께서는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서, 하늘에서 성령께서 주시는 모든 복을 우리에게 내려 주셨습니다. \v 4 세상을 만드시기 전부터 하나님께서는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 우리를 택하셔서, 우리가 사랑 안에서 그분 앞에 거룩하고 흠 없는 사람이 되게 하셨습니다. \v 5 그분은 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통해 우리를 그분의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}로 입양하시기로 미리 정하셨습니다. 그것이 그분이 기쁘게 원하신 일이었습니다. \v 6 그것은 그분이 사랑하시는 아들 안에서 우리에게 값없이 주신 그분의 영광스러운 은혜를 찬송하게 하시려는 것이었습니다. \v 7 그 아들 안에서, 그분의 피로 우리는 속량, 곧 우리 범죄의 용서를 받았습니다. 하나님의 은혜가 그만큼 풍성하기 때문입니다. \v 8 하나님께서는 그 은혜를 모든 지혜와 깨달음과 함께 우리에게 넘치도록 부어 주셨습니다. \v 9 그분은 그분의 뜻의 비밀을 우리에게 알려 주셨습니다. 그것은 그분이 기뻐하신 대로 하신 일입니다. 하나님께서는 이 계획을 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 세우셨습니다. \v 10 때가 찰 때에 이루실 그분의 계획은, 하늘에 있는 것과 땅에 있는 것, 곧 모든 것을 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 머리로 하여 그분 안에서 하나로 모으시는 것입니다. \v 11 그분 안에서 우리도 하나님의 몫으로 택함을 받았습니다. 모든 일을 그분의 뜻대로 이루시는 하나님께서 그분의 목적에 따라 우리를 미리 정하셨습니다. \v 12 그것은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께 먼저 소망을 둔 우리가 그분의 영광을 찬송하게 하시려는 것이었습니다.
ko.R: 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 하나님 아버지를 찬양합시다! 우리가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 하나가 되었기 때문에, 하나님께서는 성령께서 주시는 모든 복, 곧 하늘에 속한 복을 우리에게 주셨습니다. \v 4 하나님께서는 세상을 만드시기도 전에 우리를 택하셔서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 하나가 되게 하셨습니다. 그분은 우리가 그분 앞에서 거룩하고 흠 없는 사람이 되고, 사랑하며 살게 하시려고 우리를 택하셨습니다. \v 5 오래전에 하나님께서는 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통해 우리를 그분의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}로 입양하시기로 정하셨습니다. 우리는 그분의 자녀로서 모든 권리를 누립니다. 이것은 하나님께서 원하신 일이었고, 그분을 기쁘시게 한 일이었습니다. \v 6 하나님께서 이렇게 하신 것은 그분의 영광스러운 은혜가 찬양을 받게 하시려는 것입니다. 하나님께서는 그분이 사랑하시는 아들 안에서 이 은혜를 우리에게 값없이 주셨습니다. \v 7 그 아들이 흘리신 피로 우리는 자유롭게 되었고, 우리의 잘못도 용서받았습니다. 하나님의 은혜는 이처럼 풍성합니다. \v 8 하나님께서는 그 은혜를 우리에게 넘치도록 부어 주셨습니다. 그분은 우리에게 모든 지혜와 깨달음을 주셨습니다. \v 9 그분은 하시고자 하는 일의 비밀, 곧 전에는 감추어져 있다가 이제 알려진 그분의 계획을 우리에게 알려 주셨습니다. 하나님께서는 기쁘게 이 계획을 세우셨고, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통해 그것을 이루시려고 하셨습니다. \v 10 하나님께서 정하신 때가 오면, 하늘과 땅에 있는 모든 것을 하나로 모으시고, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 그 모든 것의 머리가 되시게 하는 것이 하나님의 계획입니다. \v 11 우리가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 하나가 되었기 때문에, 하나님께서는 우리를 그분의 백성, 그분의 소중한 몫으로 삼으셨습니다. 하나님께서는 오래전에 이것을 정하셨습니다. 하나님께서는 그분이 계획하시고 원하시는 대로 모든 일을 이루십니다. \v 12 그분이 이렇게 하신 것은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께 처음으로 소망을 둔 우리가 그분의 영광을 찬양하게 하시려는 것입니다.

vi.L: Chúc tụng Đức Chúa Trời, Cha của Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, là Đấng đã ban phước cho chúng ta trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} bằng mọi phước lành thuộc linh ở các nơi trên trời, \v 4 như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn chúng ta trong Đấng ấy trước khi sáng lập thế gian, để chúng ta được thánh khiết và không tì vết trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong tình yêu thương, \v 5 đã định trước cho chúng ta được nhận làm con của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} qua Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, theo ý muốn tốt lành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 6 để ca ngợi vinh quang của ân điển {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là ân điển {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho chúng ta trong Con Yêu Dấu, \v 7 trong Con ấy chúng ta có sự cứu chuộc bởi huyết của Con, là sự tha thứ những vi phạm, theo sự giàu có của ân điển {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 8 là ân điển {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho chúng ta dồi dào với mọi sự khôn ngoan và thông sáng, \v 9 khi cho chúng ta biết sự mầu nhiệm của ý muốn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, theo ý tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã định sẵn trong Đấng ấy \v 10 cho sự sắp đặt khi các thời kỳ được trọn: là hợp nhất muôn vật trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, cả những vật trên trời và những vật dưới đất, trong Đấng ấy, \v 11 trong Đấng ấy chúng tôi cũng đã được nhận làm cơ nghiệp [của Đức Chúa Trời], vì đã được định trước theo mục đích của Đấng làm mọi sự theo ý định của ý muốn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 12 để chúng tôi, là những người đã hy vọng trước nơi {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, làm cho vinh quang {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được ca ngợi;
vi.B: Chúc tụng Đức Chúa Trời, Cha của Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. Trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho chúng ta mọi phước lành mà Thánh Linh ban ở các nơi trên trời. \v 4 Ngay cả trước khi sáng lập thế gian, Đức Chúa Trời đã chọn chúng ta trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, để chúng ta được thánh khiết và không tì vết trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong tình yêu thương. \v 5 Ngài đã định trước cho chúng ta được nhận làm con cái của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} qua Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. Đó là điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui lòng muốn, \v 6 để ân điển vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được ca ngợi, là ân điển {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã rộng ban cho chúng ta trong Con Yêu Dấu. \v 7 Trong Con ấy và nhờ huyết của Con, chúng ta có sự cứu chuộc, tức là sự tha thứ các vi phạm của chúng ta. Chúng ta có được điều đó vì ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời thật giàu có, \v 8 là ân điển {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đổ tràn trên chúng ta, cùng với mọi sự khôn ngoan và hiểu biết. \v 9 Ngài đã cho chúng ta biết sự mầu nhiệm của ý muốn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui lòng làm. Ngài đã định mục đích ấy trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} \v 10 làm chương trình của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho khi các thời kỳ đến lúc trọn vẹn: quy tụ muôn vật lại dưới một đầu trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, cả những vật trên trời và những vật dưới đất, tất cả đều trong Đấng ấy. \v 11 Trong Đấng ấy, chúng tôi cũng đã được nhận làm phần riêng của Đức Chúa Trời. Chúng tôi đã được định trước cho điều này theo mục đích của Đức Chúa Trời, là Đấng làm nên mọi sự theo ý muốn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã định, \v 12 để chúng tôi, những người đầu tiên đặt hy vọng nơi {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, làm cho vinh quang {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được ca ngợi.
vi.R: Hãy ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời, là Cha của Chúa chúng ta, Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}! Vì chúng ta được hiệp nhất với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho chúng ta mọi phước lành mà Thánh Linh đem đến, là những phước lành từ thế giới trên trời. \v 4 Ngay cả trước khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dựng nên thế gian, Đức Chúa Trời đã chọn chúng ta để được hiệp nhất với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. Ngài chọn chúng ta để chúng ta được thánh khiết và không có lỗi gì trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và để chúng ta sống trong tình yêu thương. \v 5 Từ lâu Đức Chúa Trời đã quyết định nhận chúng ta làm con cái của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} qua Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, với mọi quyền lợi của con cái {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Đó là điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn, và điều ấy làm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui lòng. \v 6 Ngài làm điều này để ân điển vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được ca ngợi. Ngài đã ban ân điển ấy cho chúng ta cách nhưng không trong Con yêu dấu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 7 Nhờ huyết của Con {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng ta đã được giải thoát, và những điều sai trái của chúng ta được tha thứ. Ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời giàu có đến thế, \v 8 và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đổ ân điển ấy trên chúng ta cách trọn vẹn. Ngài đã ban cho chúng ta mọi sự khôn ngoan và hiểu biết. \v 9 Ngài đã cho chúng ta biết sự mầu nhiệm về điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn làm: kế hoạch của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, trước kia được giấu kín, nay đã được bày tỏ. Đức Chúa Trời vui lòng lập kế hoạch này, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lập kế hoạch ấy để thực hiện qua {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. \v 10 Đây là kế hoạch của Đức Chúa Trời cho thời điểm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã định: quy tụ mọi vật trên trời và dưới đất lại với nhau, và đặt {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} làm đầu trên tất cả. \v 11 Vì chúng tôi được hiệp nhất với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho chúng tôi trở thành dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là phần quý báu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài đã quyết định điều này từ rất lâu. Đức Chúa Trời làm cho mọi việc xảy ra đúng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hoạch định và muốn. \v 12 Ngài làm vậy để chúng tôi, là những người đầu tiên đặt hy vọng nơi {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, làm cho vinh quang {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được ca ngợi.

pt.L: Bendito [seja] o Deus e Pai do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, que nos abençoou com toda bênção espiritual nos [lugares] celestiais {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, \v 4 assim como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos escolheu {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} antes da fundação do mundo, para sermos santos e irrepreensíveis diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} em amor, \v 5 tendo-nos predestinado para a adoção como filhos por meio de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} para {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}}, segundo o beneplácito da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vontade, \v 6 para [o] louvor da glória da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} graça, com a qual {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos agraciou no Amado, \v 7 no qual temos a redenção por meio do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} sangue, o perdão das faltas, segundo a riqueza da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} graça, \v 8 que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez transbordar sobre nós em toda sabedoria e entendimento, \v 9 tendo-nos dado a conhecer o mistério da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vontade, segundo o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} beneplácito, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} propôs {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} \v 10 para [a] administração da plenitude dos tempos: resumir todas as coisas no {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, as [coisas] nos céus e as [coisas] na terra, {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}, \v 11 no qual também fomos feitos herança [de Deus], tendo sido predestinados segundo [o] propósito daquele que realiza todas as coisas segundo o conselho da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vontade, \v 12 para que nós, os que primeiro esperamos no {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, sejamos para [o] louvor da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória;
pt.B: Bendito seja o Deus e Pai do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}. {{christos:Em Cristo|No Messias}} {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos abençoou com toda bênção que o Espírito dá nos lugares celestiais. \v 4 Antes mesmo da fundação do mundo, Deus nos escolheu {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, para que fôssemos santos e sem defeito diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, em amor. \v 5 Ele nos destinou de antemão para sermos adotados como {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} próprios filhos por meio de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}. Foi isso que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quis, e quis com alegria, \v 6 para que a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} graça gloriosa fosse louvada, a graça que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos deu gratuitamente no Amado. \v 7 Nele, por meio do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} sangue, temos a redenção, o perdão das nossas faltas. Temos isso porque a graça de Deus é muito rica, \v 8 graça que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} derramou sobre nós em abundância, com toda sabedoria e entendimento. \v 9 Ele nos deu a conhecer o mistério da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vontade, como {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} agradou fazer. Ele estabeleceu esse propósito {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} \v 10 como o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} plano para quando os tempos chegassem à plenitude: reunir todas as coisas sob uma só cabeça {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, as coisas do céu e as da terra, todas {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}. \v 11 Nele também fomos tomados como a porção que pertence a Deus. Fomos destinados para isso de antemão pelo propósito de Deus, que realiza todas as coisas como a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vontade determina, \v 12 para que nós, os primeiros a pôr a esperança {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, déssemos louvor à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória.
pt.R: Louvado seja o Deus e Pai do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}! Porque estamos unidos {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}}, Deus nos abençoou com todas as bênçãos que o Espírito traz, bênçãos do mundo celestial. \v 4 Antes mesmo de criar o mundo, Deus nos escolheu para estarmos unidos {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}}. Ele nos escolheu para sermos santos e sem defeito diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, e para vivermos em amor. \v 5 Há muito tempo, Deus decidiu nos adotar por meio de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} como {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} próprios filhos, com todos os direitos de filhos {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. Era isso que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} queria, e isso {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} deu alegria. \v 6 Ele fez isso para que a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} graça gloriosa fosse louvada. Ele nos deu essa graça gratuitamente no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} Filho amado. \v 7 Pelo sangue do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} Filho fomos libertados, e os nossos erros foram perdoados. É tão rica a graça de Deus, \v 8 e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} a derramou sobre nós em grande medida. Ele nos deu toda sabedoria e entendimento. \v 9 Ele nos fez conhecer o mistério do que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} queria fazer: o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} plano, antes escondido, agora revelado. Deus teve alegria em fazer esse plano, e o fez para ser realizado por meio {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}. \v 10 Este é o plano de Deus para o tempo que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} marcou: reunir tudo o que existe no céu e na terra, com {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} como cabeça sobre tudo. \v 11 Porque estamos unidos {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}}, Deus fez de nós o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio povo, a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} parte preciosa. Ele decidiu isso muito tempo antes. Deus faz tudo acontecer do jeito que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} planejou e quis. \v 12 Ele fez isso para que nós, os primeiros a pôr a esperança {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, trouxéssemos louvor à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória.

am.L: የጌታችን የኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} አምላክና አባት የተባረከ [ይሁን]፤ እርሱ {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} በሰማያዊ [ስፍራዎች] በመንፈሳዊ በረከት ሁሉ ባረከን፤ \v 4 በፊቱ በፍቅር ቅዱሳንና ነውር የሌለብን እንድንሆን ከዓለም መመሥረት በፊት በእርሱ እንደ መረጠን፤ \v 5 በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} በኩል ለራሱ ልጅነት አስቀድሞ ወሰነን፤ [ይህም] እንደ ፈቃዱ በጎ ደስታ ነው፤ \v 6 በተወደደው በነጻ የሰጠን የጸጋው ክብር ይመሰገን ዘንድ ነው፤ \v 7 በእርሱ በደሙ በኩል ቤዛነት፣ የበደሎች ይቅርታ አለን፤ [ይህም] እንደ ጸጋው ባለ ጠግነት ነው፤ \v 8 [ይህንም ጸጋ] በጥበብና በማስተዋል ሁሉ አበዛልን፤ \v 9 በእርሱ እንዳሰበው እንደ በጎ ደስታው የፈቃዱን ምሥጢር አስታወቀን፤ \v 10 [ይህም] ለዘመናት ሙላት አሠራር ነው፤ ሁሉን ነገር፣ በሰማያት ያለውንና በምድር ያለውን፣ {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} በአንድ ራስ ሥር ለመጠቅለል ነው፤ በእርሱ፣ \v 11 በእርሱም ደግሞ [የእግዚአብሔር] ርስት ሆንን፤ ሁሉን እንደ ፈቃዱ ምክር የሚሠራው እንዳሰበው አስቀድመን ተወስነን ነበር፤ \v 12 ይኸውም አስቀድመን {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} ተስፋ ያደረግን እኛ ለክብሩ ምስጋና እንድንሆን ነው፤
am.B: የጌታችን የኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} አምላክና አባት ይባረክ። እርሱ {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} በሰማያዊ ስፍራዎች መንፈስ በሚሰጠው በረከት ሁሉ ባርኮናል። \v 4 እግዚአብሔር ዓለም ከመመሥረቱ በፊት {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} መረጠን፤ ይህም በፊቱ በፍቅር ቅዱሳንና ነውር የሌለብን እንድንሆን ነው። \v 5 በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} በኩል ልጅነትን ሰጥቶ የራሱ ልጆች ሊያደርገን አስቀድሞ ወሰነን። ይህን ያደረገው በደስታ ስለ ፈቀደ ነው፤ \v 6 ይኸውም በተወደደው በነጻ የሰጠን የክብር ጸጋው እንዲመሰገን ነው። \v 7 በእርሱና በደሙ ቤዛነትን፣ ማለትም የበደላችንን ይቅርታ፣ አግኝተናል። ይህን ያገኘነው የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ እጅግ ባለ ጠጋ ስለ ሆነ ነው፤ \v 8 ይህንም ጸጋ በጥበብና በማስተዋል ሁሉ አትረፍርፎ አፈሰሰልን። \v 9 እርሱ እንደ ወደደ የፈቃዱን ምሥጢር አስታወቀን። ይህን ዓላማ {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} አስቀድሞ አቀደው፤ \v 10 ይህም ዘመናት ሙላታቸውን በሚያገኙበት ጊዜ የሚፈጸም ዕቅዱ ነው፤ በሰማይ ያለውንና በምድር ያለውን ሁሉ {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} በአንድ ራስ ሥር ማሰባሰብ ነው። ሁሉም በእርሱ አንድ ይሆናል። \v 11 በእርሱ እኛ ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔር ድርሻ ሆነን ተወስደናል። ሁሉን ነገር ፈቃዱ እንደ ወሰነው በሚሠራው በእግዚአብሔር ዓላማ ለዚህ አስቀድመን ተወስነናል፤ \v 12 ይኸውም አስቀድመን {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} ተስፋ ያደረግን እኛ ለክብሩ ምስጋና እንድናመጣ ነው።
am.R: የጌታችን የኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} አምላክና አባት ይመስገን! {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሕ}} ጋር አንድ ስለ ሆንን እግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ቅዱስ በሚያመጣው በረከት ሁሉ ባርኮናል፤ እነዚህም ከሰማያዊው ዓለም የሆኑ በረከቶች ናቸው። \v 4 እግዚአብሔር ዓለምን ከመፍጠሩ በፊት {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሕ}} ጋር አንድ እንድንሆን መረጠን። በፊቱ ቅዱሳንና ነቀፋ የሌለብን እንድንሆንና በፍቅር እንድንኖር መረጠን። \v 5 እግዚአብሔር ከብዙ ዘመን በፊት በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} በኩል የራሱ ልጆች አድርጎ ሊቀበለን ወሰነ፤ የልጆቹንም መብት ሁሉ ሊሰጠን ወሰነ። እርሱ የፈለገው ይህ ነበር፤ ደስም አሰኘው። \v 6 ይህን ያደረገው ታላቅና ክቡር ጸጋው እንዲመሰገን ነው። ይህን ጸጋ በሚወደው ልጁ በነጻ ሰጥቶናል። \v 7 በልጁ ደም ነጻ ወጥተናል፤ በደላችንም ተሰርዮልናል። የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ይህን ያህል ባለ ጠጋ ነው፤ \v 8 ይህንም ጸጋ በሙላት አፈሰሰልን። ጥበብንና ማስተዋልንም ሁሉ ሰጠን። \v 9 ሊያደርግ የፈለገውን ምሥጢር አሳወቀን፤ ይህም ቀድሞ ተሰውሮ የነበረውና አሁን የተገለጠው ዕቅዱ ነው። እግዚአብሔር ይህን ዕቅድ ሲያወጣ ደስ አለው፤ {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} በኩል እንዲፈጸምም አደረገው። \v 10 እግዚአብሔር ለወሰነው ጊዜ ያወጣው ዕቅድ ይህ ነው፤ በሰማይና በምድር ያለውን ሁሉ አንድ ላይ ሰብስቦ {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሑን}} በሁሉ ላይ ራስ ማድረግ ነው። \v 11 {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሕ}} ጋር አንድ ስለ ሆንን እግዚአብሔር የራሱ ሕዝብ፣ የከበረ ድርሻውም አደረገን። ይህን ከብዙ ጊዜ በፊት ወሰነ። እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን ነገር እንዳቀደውና እንደ ፈቀደው ያደርጋል። \v 12 ይህን ያደረገው {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} ተስፋ ለማድረግ የመጀመሪያዎቹ የሆንን እኛ ለክብሩ ምስጋና እንድናመጣ ነው።

hi.L: हमारे प्रभु यीशु मसीह के परमेश्वर और पिता धन्य [हों], जिन्होंने हमें मसीह में स्वर्गीय स्थानों में हर प्रकार की आत्मिक आशीष दी है, \v 4 जैसा उन्होंने हमें संसार की नींव डालने से पहले उनमें चुन लिया, कि हम प्रेम में उनके सामने पवित्र और निर्दोष हों, \v 5 और उन्होंने हमें यीशु मसीह के द्वारा अपने लिए {{gender:सन्तान|पुत्र}} के रूप में गोद लिए जाने के लिए पहले से ठहराया, अपनी इच्छा के भले अभिप्राय के अनुसार, \v 6 अपने अनुग्रह की महिमा की स्तुति के लिए, जिससे उन्होंने हमें उस प्रिय में अनुग्रहित किया, \v 7 जिनमें हमें उनके लहू के द्वारा छुटकारा, अर्थात् अपराधों की क्षमा, उनके अनुग्रह के धन के अनुसार मिला है, \v 8 जिसे उन्होंने सारी बुद्धि और समझ के साथ हम पर बहुतायत से किया, \v 9 और अपनी इच्छा का भेद हम पर प्रकट किया, अपने उस भले अभिप्राय के अनुसार जो उन्होंने उनमें ठान लिया था, \v 10 समयों की पूर्णता के प्रबंध के लिए: कि सब कुछ मसीह में एक साथ समेटें, जो स्वर्ग में है और जो पृथ्वी पर है, उन्हीं में, \v 11 जिनमें हम भी [परमेश्वर की] मीरास बनाए गए, उनके उद्देश्य के अनुसार पहले से ठहराए जाकर जो सब कुछ अपनी इच्छा की युक्ति के अनुसार करते हैं, \v 12 ताकि हम, जिन्होंने पहले से मसीह पर आशा रखी थी, उनकी महिमा की स्तुति का कारण हों;
hi.B: हमारे प्रभु यीशु मसीह के परमेश्वर और पिता धन्य हों। उन्होंने मसीह में हमें स्वर्गीय स्थानों में वह हर आशीष दी है जो आत्मा देता है। \v 4 संसार की नींव डालने से पहले ही परमेश्वर ने हमें मसीह में चुन लिया, ताकि हम प्रेम में उनके सामने पवित्र और निर्दोष हों। \v 5 उन्होंने हमें पहले से ठहरा दिया कि हम यीशु मसीह के द्वारा {{gender:उनकी अपनी सन्तान|उनके अपने पुत्र}} के रूप में गोद लिए जाएँ। यही उनकी प्रसन्न इच्छा थी, \v 6 ताकि उनके महिमामय अनुग्रह की स्तुति हो, वह अनुग्रह जो उन्होंने उस प्रिय में हमें मुफ़्त में दिया है। \v 7 उन्हीं में और उनके लहू के द्वारा हमें छुटकारा, अर्थात् हमारे अपराधों की क्षमा, मिला है। यह हमें इसलिए मिला है कि परमेश्वर का अनुग्रह इतना धनी है, \v 8 वह अनुग्रह जो उन्होंने सारी बुद्धि और समझ के साथ हम पर भरपूरी से उँडेल दिया है। \v 9 उन्होंने अपनी इच्छा का भेद हम पर प्रकट किया है, जैसा उन्हें भाया। यह उद्देश्य उन्होंने मसीह में ठहराया, \v 10 अपनी उस योजना के रूप में जो समय पूरा होने पर पूरी होगी: कि सब कुछ, जो स्वर्ग में है और जो पृथ्वी पर है, मसीह में, एक सिर के अधीन, एक साथ इकट्ठा करें। \v 11 उन्हीं में परमेश्वर ने हमें भी अपना भाग ठहराया है। परमेश्वर के उद्देश्य के अनुसार हम इसके लिए पहले से ठहराए गए थे, उन परमेश्वर के, जो सब कुछ अपनी इच्छा के अनुसार पूरा करते हैं, \v 12 ताकि हम, जिन्होंने सबसे पहले मसीह पर आशा रखी, उनकी महिमा की स्तुति का कारण बनें।
hi.R: हमारे प्रभु यीशु मसीह के परमेश्वर और पिता की स्तुति हो! क्योंकि हम मसीह से जुड़े हैं, इसलिए परमेश्वर ने हमें वह हर आशीष दी है जो आत्मा लाता है, स्वर्गीय लोक की आशीषें। \v 4 संसार को बनाने से पहले ही परमेश्वर ने हमें चुन लिया कि हम मसीह से जुड़ें। उन्होंने हमें इसलिए चुना कि हम उनकी दृष्टि में पवित्र और निर्दोष हों, और प्रेम में जिएँ। \v 5 बहुत पहले परमेश्वर ने ठान लिया कि वे यीशु मसीह के द्वारा हमें गोद लेकर {{gender:अपनी सन्तान|अपने पुत्र}} बनाएँगे, और हमें अपनी सन्तान के सारे अधिकार देंगे। यही वे चाहते थे, और इससे उन्हें आनंद मिला। \v 6 उन्होंने यह इसलिए किया कि उनके महिमामय अनुग्रह की स्तुति हो। यह अनुग्रह उन्होंने हमें अपने प्रिय पुत्र में मुफ़्त में दिया है। \v 7 उनके पुत्र के लहू के द्वारा हम स्वतंत्र किए गए हैं, और हमारे ग़लत काम क्षमा किए गए हैं। परमेश्वर का अनुग्रह इतना धनी है, \v 8 और उन्होंने उसे भरपूर मात्रा में हम पर उँडेल दिया है। उन्होंने हमें सारी बुद्धि और समझ दी है। \v 9 उन्होंने हमें बता दिया है कि वे क्या करना चाहते थे: उनकी योजना, जो पहले छिपी थी, अब प्रकट की गई है। परमेश्वर ने ख़ुशी से यह योजना बनाई, और इसे मसीह के द्वारा पूरा करने के लिए बनाया। \v 10 परमेश्वर की यह योजना उस समय के लिए है जो उन्होंने ठहराया है: कि स्वर्ग में और पृथ्वी पर सब कुछ एक साथ लाएँ, और मसीह उन सब के ऊपर सिर हों। \v 11 क्योंकि हम मसीह से जुड़े हैं, इसलिए परमेश्वर ने हमें अपने लोग, अपना अनमोल भाग बना लिया है। उन्होंने यह बहुत पहले ठान लिया था। परमेश्वर सब कुछ वैसे ही करते हैं जैसा उन्होंने योजना बनाई और चाहा है। \v 12 उन्होंने यह इसलिए किया कि हम, जिन्होंने सबसे पहले मसीह पर आशा रखी, उनकी महिमा की स्तुति का कारण बनें।

ru.L: Благословен Бог и Отец Господа нашего Иисуса {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}, благословивший нас всяким духовным благословением в небесных [местах] {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}}, \v 4 так как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} избрал нас в {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} прежде основания мира, чтобы мы были святы и непорочны перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} в любви, \v 5 предопределив нас к усыновлению через Иисуса {{christos:Христа|Мессию}} для себя по благоволению своей воли, \v 6 в похвалу славы своей благодати, которой {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} одарил нас в Возлюбленном, \v 7 в котором мы имеем искупление через {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} кровь, прощение прегрешений, по богатству {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} благодати, \v 8 которую {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} в избытке даровал нам во всякой мудрости и разумении, \v 9 открыв нам тайну своей воли по своему благоволению, которое {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} прежде положил в {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} \v 10 для устроения полноты времён: соединить всё под одной главой {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}}, небесное и земное, в {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}}, \v 11 в котором мы и сделались [Божьим] уделом, будучи предопределены по намерению того, кто совершает всё по совету своей воли, \v 12 чтобы нам, прежде уже надеявшимся на {{christos:Христа|Мессию}}, быть в похвалу {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} славы;
ru.B: Благословен Бог и Отец нашего Господа Иисуса {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}. {{christos:Во Христе|В Мессии}} {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} благословил нас всяким благословением, которое даёт Дух, в небесном мире. \v 4 Ещё до основания мира Бог избрал нас {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}}, чтобы мы были святы и непорочны перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} в любви. \v 5 Он заранее определил, что через Иисуса {{christos:Христа|Мессию}} усыновит нас как своих {{gender:сыновей и дочерей|сыновей}}. Так {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} с радостью пожелал, \v 6 чтобы прославлялась {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} славная благодать, которой {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} щедро одарил нас в Возлюбленном. \v 7 В {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}}, через {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} кровь, мы имеем искупление, прощение наших прегрешений. Мы имеем его, потому что Божья благодать так богата, \v 8 благодать, которую {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} в изобилии излил на нас со всякой мудростью и разумением. \v 9 Он открыл нам тайну своей воли, как {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} было угодно. Этот замысел {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} положил {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} \v 10 как свой план на то время, когда сроки достигнут полноты: соединить всё под одной главой {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}}, и небесное, и земное, — всё в {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}}. \v 11 В {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} и мы стали Божьим уделом. Мы были заранее определены к этому по замыслу Бога, который совершает всё так, как решает {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} воля, \v 12 чтобы мы, первыми возложившие надежду на {{christos:Христа|Мессию}}, служили к прославлению {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} славы.
ru.R: Хвала Богу и Отцу нашего Господа Иисуса {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}! Потому что мы соединены с {{christos:Христом|Мессией}}, Бог благословил нас всяким благословением, которое приносит Дух, — благословениями из небесного мира. \v 4 Ещё до того, как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} создал мир, Бог избрал нас, чтобы мы были соединены с {{christos:Христом|Мессией}}. Он избрал нас, чтобы мы были святыми и безупречными в {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} глазах и жили в любви. \v 5 Давным-давно Бог решил через Иисуса {{christos:Христа|Мессию}} усыновить нас как своих {{gender:сыновей и дочерей|сыновей}}, со всеми правами своих детей. Этого {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} хотел, и это радовало {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. \v 6 Он сделал это, чтобы люди прославляли {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} славную благодать. Эту благодать {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} даром дал нам в своём горячо любимом Сыне. \v 7 Через кровь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} Сына мы освобождены, и наши проступки прощены. Вот как богата Божья благодать, \v 8 и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} излил её на нас в полной мере. Он дал нам всю мудрость и понимание. \v 9 Он открыл нам тайну того, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} хотел сделать: свой замысел, прежде скрытый, а теперь открытый. Бог с радостью задумал этот план и задумал его так, чтобы он исполнился через {{christos:Христа|Мессию}}. \v 10 Вот Божий замысел на время, которое {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} назначил: соединить всё на небе и на земле, и чтобы {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} был главой над всем. \v 11 Потому что мы соединены с {{christos:Христом|Мессией}}, Бог сделал нас своим народом, своим драгоценным уделом. Он решил это задолго до этого. Бог делает так, что всё происходит, как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} задумал и пожелал. \v 12 Он сделал это, чтобы мы, первыми возложившие надежду на {{christos:Христа|Мессию}}, приносили хвалу {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} славе.

uk.L: Благословенний Бог і Отець Господа нашого Ісуса {{christos:Христа|Месії}}, який благословив нас усяким духовним благословенням у небесних [місцях] {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}}, \v 4 так як {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} вибрав нас у {{deity_pronoun:ньому|Ньому}} перед заснуванням світу, щоб ми були святі й бездоганні перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} у любові, \v 5 наперед визначивши нас до усиновлення [як] {{gender:синів і дочок|синів}} через Ісуса {{christos:Христа|Месію}} для себе, за благоволінням своєї волі, \v 6 на хвалу слави {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} благодаті, якою {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} обдарував нас в Улюбленому, \v 7 в якому ми маємо викуплення через {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} кров, прощення провин, за багатством {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} благодаті, \v 8 яку {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} щедро вилив на нас у всякій мудрості й розумінні, \v 9 давши нам пізнати таємницю своєї волі, за своїм благоволінням, яке {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} наперед поклав у {{deity_pronoun:ньому|Ньому}} \v 10 для задуму повноти часів: звести все під одну голову {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}}, те, що на небесах, і те, що на землі, у {{deity_pronoun:ньому|Ньому}}, \v 11 в якому ми й стали [Божим] уділом, наперед визначені за наміром того, хто чинить усе за порадою своєї волі, \v 12 щоб ми, які першими поклали надію на {{christos:Христа|Месію}}, були на хвалу {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} слави;
uk.B: Благословенний Бог і Отець нашого Господа Ісуса {{christos:Христа|Месії}}. {{christos:У Христі|В Месії}} {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} благословив нас на небесах усяким благословенням, яке дає Дух. \v 4 Ще до створення світу Бог вибрав нас {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}}, щоб ми були святі й непорочні перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} у любові. \v 5 Він наперед призначив нас, щоб через Ісуса {{christos:Христа|Месію}} усиновити нас як своїх {{gender:синів і дочок|синів}}. Так {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} радо забажав, \v 6 щоб звучала хвала {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} славній благодаті, якою {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} щедро обдарував нас в Улюбленому. \v 7 У {{deity_pronoun:ньому|Ньому}} і через {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} кров ми маємо викуплення, прощення наших провин. Це нам дано, бо Божа благодать така багата, \v 8 благодать, яку {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} рясно вилив на нас з усією мудрістю й розумінням. \v 9 Він відкрив нам таємницю своєї волі, як {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} було до вподоби. Цей задум {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} поклав {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} \v 10 як свій план на час, коли настане повнота часів: звести все під одну голову {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}}, те, що на небі, і те, що на землі, — усе в {{deity_pronoun:ньому|Ньому}}. \v 11 У {{deity_pronoun:ньому|Ньому}} і ми стали Божим уділом. Нас наперед призначив до цього задум Бога, який здійснює все так, як вирішує {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} воля, \v 12 щоб ми, які першими поклали надію на {{christos:Христа|Месію}}, були на хвалу {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} слави.
